KAINAT BAGS - Complete Handbag Store Website

HOW TO OPEN
1. Extract KAINAT_Bags_Website.zip.
2. Open the HTML folder.
3. Double-click index.html. Use Google Chrome for the best experience.

FOLDER STRUCTURE
HTML/index.html
CSS/style.css
JavaScript/script.js
Images/ (11 photos supplied in this chat)

INCLUDED
- All 11 of your uploaded handbag photos copied into Images/
- Responsive boutique design in burgundy, blush and cream
- 11 product cards with names and sample prices in PKR
- Product category filters and search
- Price sorting
- Wishlist buttons
- Working shopping cart and subtotal
- WhatsApp order message
- Newsletter demo interaction

IMPORTANT BEFORE PUBLISHING
- The WhatsApp button currently opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled order message but does not target a specific business number. In JavaScript/script.js, replace the wa.me/ URL with wa.me/YOUR_COUNTRY_CODE_AND_NUMBER.
- Product prices are sample prices; edit them in JavaScript/script.js to your actual prices.
- Newsletter form is a front-end demo and does not store email addresses.
- Google Fonts require internet; all handbag photos are included locally and do not require internet.
